summary: Tested new /api/ontology/reset endpoint, empty-JSON guard-rail, TXT-via-Gemini import, and Ontology page reset button. All 5 backend pytest cases passed (11.17s) and frontend reset flow works end-to-end (window.confirm mocked, POST /ontology/reset called, version metadata returns to 1.0.0-seed with 72 total elements). Seed is left ACTIVE for the user (final reset test).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py parse_ontology_file correctly routes PDF/DOCX/MD/TXT to parse_ontology_with_gemini and preserves canonical schema keys.
Guard-rail (total==0 -> HTTP 400 with 'Nenhum elemento cognitivo encontrado') works and includes actionable message referencing the new reset button.
/api/ontology/reset reactivates existing seed doc if present (idempotent) — good; avoids duplicate seed docs.
cognitive_engine.parse_ontology_with_gemini uses the same LlmChat/emergentintegrations pattern as run_cognitive_pipeline — consistent.
Frontend Ontology.jsx uses window.confirm before reset (as required) and disables buttons during busy state.
seed_data_creation: Test imports a small TEST-BEFORE-RESET / TEST-JSON-OK ontology then resets back to 1.0.0-seed. Final state: 1.0.0-seed active (as requested).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL must be loaded from /app/frontend/.env via python-dotenv in test files. Backend pytest config disables xdist args via -o addopts='' when running a single file. Gemini TXT parse takes ~5s and reliably produces >=1 dominio/processo for the sample. Frontend reset requires mocking window.confirm=()=>true before clicking [data-testid=ontology-reset-btn].
